title: Strength only, no run

steps.target: single-leg strength, glute med / hip abductor focus

coachNotes: HRV 49 (vs ~62 baseline) the morning after a 138-load Saturday. Run dropped entirely, not shortened. Strength only: single-leg work, glute med and hip abductors, the ITB-protective set. No plyo, no loaded descent. Week 4 closes at 175 load.
